@replay : ∀ {σ : Type u_2} (f d e : σ →₀ ℕ),
  hasseCoeff d (f + d) * hasseCoeff e (f + d + e) = hasseCoeff d (d + e) * hasseCoeff (d + e) (f + (d + e))

@hasseDeriv_hasseDeriv : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (d e : σ →₀ ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (hasseDeriv d) ((hasseDeriv e) P) = ↑(hasseCoeff d (d + e)) • (hasseDeriv (d + e)) P

@hasseDeriv_hasseDeriv_of_disjoint : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d e : σ →₀ ℕ},
  Disjoint d.support e.support → ∀ (P : MvPolynomial σ R), (hasseDeriv d) ((hasseDeriv e) P) = (hasseDeriv (d + e)) P

@Finsupp.disjoint_iff : ∀ {ι : Type u_3} {α : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α]
  [inst_2 : IsBotZeroClass α] {f g : ι →₀ α}, Disjoint f g ↔ Disjoint f.support g.support

@pderiv_hasseDeriv : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (j : σ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (P : MvPolynomial σ R), (pderiv j) ((hasseDeriv d) P) = ↑(d j + 1) • (hasseDeriv (d + Finsupp.single j 1)) P

@degreeOf_hasseDeriv_le : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (j : σ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (P : MvPolynomial σ R), degreeOf j ((hasseDeriv d) P) ≤ degreeOf j P

@hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_degreeOf_lt : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {j : σ} {d : σ →₀ ℕ}
  {P : MvPolynomial σ R}, degreeOf j P < d j → (hasseDeriv d) P = 0

@hasseDeriv_mul_of_degreeOf_eq_zero : ∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d : σ →₀ ℕ}
  {f g : MvPolynomial σ R}, (∀ j ∈ d.support, degreeOf j f = 0) → (hasseDeriv d) (f * g) = f * (hasseDeriv d) g

@mem_vars_iff_degreeOf_ne_zero : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {i : σ},
  i ∈ p.vars ↔ degreeOf i p ≠ 0

@pderiv_mul : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {i : σ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
  (pderiv i) (f * g) = (pderiv i) f * g + f * (pderiv i) g

@linearMap_ext : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {M : Type u_5} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] M}, (∀ (s : σ →₀ ℕ), f ∘ₗ monomial s = g ∘ₗ monomial s) → f = g

@Polynomial.hasseDeriv_monomial : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k n : ℕ) (r : R),

                          (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (MvPolynomial.eval_X x_2)) (MvPolynomial.eval_C (α x_2)))))
                      (x_1 x_2))))))))
    (congrArg (⇑(MvPolynomial.eval x)) (MvPolynomial.eq_sum_box_hasseDeriv α r P hP))

@target : ∀ {σ : Type u_4} {A : Type u_5} {B : Type u_6} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B]
  [inst_2 : Algebra A B] [inst_3 : Fintype σ] (α : σ → A) (x : σ → B) (r : σ → ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ A),
  (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
    (aeval x) P =
      ∑ d ∈ Roth.box r, (algebraMap A B) ((eval α) ((hasseDeriv d) P)) * ∏ j, (x j - (algebraMap A B) (α j)) ^ d j

@target : ∀ {σ : Type u_4} {A : Type u_5} {B : Type u_6} [inst : CommSemiring A] [inst_1 : CommRing B]
  [inst_2 : Algebra A B] [inst_3 : Fintype σ] (α x : σ → B) (r : σ → ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ A),
  (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
    (aeval x) P = ∑ d ∈ Roth.box r, (aeval α) ((hasseDeriv d) P) * ∏ j, (x j - α j) ^ d j
@normOne : {σ : Type u_2} → MvPolynomial σ ℤ → ℝ

def Roth.normOne.{u_1} : {σ : Type u_1} → MvPolynomial σ ℤ → ℝ :=
fun {σ} P ↦ ∑ d ∈ P.support, |↑(P.coeff d)|
@arbitraryNorm : {σ : Type u_2} → {R : Type u_3} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → [Norm R] → MvPolynomial σ R → ℝ

@finiteCoefficientSize : {ι : Type u_2} →
  {R : Type u_3} → {S : Type u_4} → [inst : Zero R] → [AddCommMonoid S] → (R → S) → (ι →₀ R) → S
@diag : {σ : Type u_1} → MvPolynomial σ ℤ → ℤ[X]

def Roth.diag.{u_1} : {σ : Type u_1} → MvPolynomial σ ℤ → ℤ[X] :=
fun {σ} P ↦ (MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ Polynomial.X) P
@generalized : {σ : Type u_2} → {R : Type u_3} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → R[X]
MvPolynomial.aeval fun x ↦ Polynomial.X : MvPolynomial (ULift.{u, 0} Unit) ℕ →ₐ[ℕ] ℕ[X]
@Roth.normOne_nonneg : ∀ {σ : Type u_2} (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ), 0 ≤ Roth.normOne P

theorem Roth.normOne_nonneg.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ), 0 ≤ Roth.normOne P :=
fun {σ} P ↦ Finset.sum_nonneg fun x x_1 ↦ abs_nonneg ↑(P.coeff x)

Finset.sum_nonneg: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : Preorder N] {f : ι → N}
  {s : Finset ι} [AddLeftMono N], (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) → 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f i
abs_nonneg: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Lattice α] [inst_1 : AddGroup α] [AddLeftMono α] [AddRightMono α] (a : α), 0 ≤ |a|

Finsupp.sum_nonneg: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β]
  [inst_2 : Preorder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] {f : ι →₀ α} {h₁ : ι → α → β},
  (∀ i ∈ f.support, 0 ≤ h₁ i (f i)) → 0 ≤ f.sum h₁
norm_nonneg: ∀ {E : Type u_4} [inst : SeminormedAddGroup E] (a : E), 0 ≤ ‖a‖

@Roth.normOne_eq_sum_of_support_subset : ∀ {σ : Type u_2} {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {s : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)},
  P.support ⊆ s → Roth.normOne P = ∑ d ∈ s, |↑(P.coeff d)|

theorem Roth.normOne_eq_sum_of_support_subset.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {s : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)},
  P.support ⊆ s → Roth.normOne P = ∑ d ∈ s, |↑(P.coeff d)| :=
fun {σ} {P} {s} hs ↦
  Finset.sum_subset hs fun d x hd ↦
    of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans (congrArg abs (Eq.trans (congrArg Int.cast (notMem_support_iff.mp hd)) Int.cast_zero)) abs_zero))
          0)
        (eq_self 0))
